incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER: Page fired — metric=latency.p95; region=us-west; value=3.4s; threshold=3.0s; window=5m; PD: PD-4281

alex: acked PD-4281, I'm on it. grabbing dashboards and logs now.

josh: seeing the same in grafana — p95 jumped ~2x around 17:02 UTC. any deployments?

alex: no deployments in last 30m from CI. quick check: autoscale activity seems normal.

priya: copying runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/latency-p95 (follow playbook section 2).

alex: running query on request size distribution:```sql
SELECT bucket, count(*) FROM request_sizes WHERE region='us-west' AND ts > now() - 10m GROUP BY bucket;
```looks like a spike in 1-2k token requests, batching looks heavier.

marta: any hotkeys? could be KV cache thrash. @alex can you check kvcache hit rate?

alex: kvcache hit rate down from 98% -> 72% in the window. logs show frequent KV evictions from node-12. snippet:```text
2025-06-12T17:04:12Z node-12 eviction: keys=12456 free=200MB
2025-06-12T17:04:13Z request id=abcd batch=28 tokens=1800
```

priya: impact assessment — initial customer impact: small percentage of requests delayed > 3s, error rate unchanged. marking "degraded" (P0 watch). Not a complete outage.

josh: mitigation options: 1) increase kvcache size on node-12, 2) pin hot prefixes to avoid eviction, 3) enable regional fallback routing to eu-west for high-SLO customers. Which do we want now?

alex: doing quick kvcache bump (rolling) on node-12, will monitor. started command:```sh
./infractl node update node-12 --kvcache-size=4GB
``` ETA ~2m.

sre-bot: action logged: infractl job 89234 started by alex. Notifying autoscaler for temporary buffer.

marta: if bump doesn't stabilize in 10m we should enable fallback routes for high-tier customers. preparing a canary rule.

alex: bump completed. preliminary p95 down to 2.1s after 90s. continuing to monitor.

priya: thanks. PD-4281 annotated with mitigation steps. I'll stay on until stabilized and then hand off to on-call at 18:00 UTC.

josh: noted — please add post-incident follow-up: examine root cause of K/V churn and batching patterns.

incident-bot: Page PD-4281 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigated (temporary fix).

priya: confirm customer impact: degraded for ~9 minutes, approx 1.7% of requests >3s. no errors, customers not filing support tickets yet. we'll run a targeted eval to validate output quality for routed fallback.

alex: will collect heap/kvcache metrics and snapshot logs for postmortem. link will be in PD ticket.

marta: adding postmortem owners: alex (primary), priya (ops), josh (runtime).

priya: handing off to next on-call @josh at 18:00 UTC if stable. I'll update PD and close the page once the SLO window shows sustained recovery. :white_check_mark:

josh: taking handoff. leaving a short checklist in PD: metrics stable for 10m, kvcache rates >95%, p95 < 1.5s.

incident-bot: PD-4281: page closed by priya at 17:13 UTC (mitigated)"
